mixing_order_reasoning: From Chemistry Plan: TBHP/NaBr/H2SO4 mixed with alcohol in Stage 1. Morpholine added at interstage to react with oxidized intermediate. T-mixers provide sufficient mixing for laminar flow regimes in this context.
pre_reactor_steps: Degas dioxane solvent with N2 sparging for 10 min to remove dissolved oxygen, although not strictly required for yield, it improves safety with TBHP.
post_reactor_steps: Quench reaction mixture with saturated NaHCO3 solution to neutralize sulfuric acid and stop reaction.
chemistry_notes: Two-stage oxidative amidation. Stage 1 (5 mL) oxidizes benzyl alcohol to benzoyl bromide/acid intermediate using TBHP/NaBr/H2SO4. Stage 2 (10 mL) amidates with morpholine. TBHP and morpholine are incompatible and must be segregated. Reaction is thermal (80 C); no light source needed. Axial dispersion (Pe=35) is significant but acceptable for this kinetic regime. Mixing is critical (Da=7.9); interstage addition ensures morpholine only contacts oxidized intermediate.
